scenario.description: Sustained bullish trend: price above SMA20 above SMA50, positive momentum, RSI in bullish territory, order flow tilted to bid side.
notes: Price, SMA20, SMA50, momentum, RSI, and order-book imbalance all converge bullish.

scenario.description: Sharp single-window price drop with elevated panic volume and negative order-book imbalance.
notes: A sharp single-window move - the system prompt explicitly warns against overreacting to one candle, so both HOLD and a well-justified OPEN_SHORT are acceptable; only a contradictory OPEN_LONG is graded as a conflict.

scenario.description: Volume collapse (volumeRatio well below 1) - thin, low-conviction trading.
notes: Thin volume is a reason for caution, not a directional signal.

scenario.description: RSI deep in oversold territory in isolation, without independent confirming signals.
notes: Mirror of overbought - not strictly graded.

scenario.description: Existing LONG position experiencing an ordinary small adverse wiggle - original thesis is not materially challenged.
notes: Graded strictly: closing here (CLOSE_LONG) on this little noise is an evidence conflict per the system prompt's own 'do not close on ordinary noise' rule.
position.liquidationPrice on this scenario is synthetic test-data math (see approxLiquidationPrice in this file), NOT Bitget's real liquidation formula.
